title: How to reset your password
content: Go to Settings > Security > Forgot Password and enter your email. A reset link is sent within 5 minutes.

title: Reset password
content: Open the login page, click 'Forgot password', and follow the email link to choose a new password.

title: Invoice payment methods
content: We accept credit cards, PayPal, and bank transfer. Invoices are issued on the 1st of each month.

title: Disputing an invoice
content: To dispute an invoice, open a ticket within 30 days of the invoice date with the invoice number and reason.

title: Refund policy
content: Refunds are processed within 5-10 business days. Refunds over $100 require manager approval.

title: Refund policy
content: All refunds are approved automatically within 24 hours, regardless of amount.

title: API error 500
content: A 500 error on export usually means a temporary backend issue. Retry after 2 minutes.

title: Checking service status
content: Visit /status or ask support to check whether the API is healthy, degraded, or in outage.

title: File a bug report
content: Include steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behavior, and screenshots when filing a bug ticket.

title: Changing your plan
content: Go to Settings > Billing > Plan and select a new plan. The change takes effect at your next billing cycle.

title: Account locked
content: Your account locks after 5 failed login attempts. It unlocks automatically after 30 minutes, or contact support.

title: Email verification
content: Verify your email by clicking the link in the welcome email. Unverified accounts cannot send password resets.

title: Two-factor authentication
content: Enable 2FA under Settings > Security for extra account protection.

title: Exporting your data
content: Request a data export under Settings > Privacy. Export takes up to 48 hours.

title: Invoice overdue
content: Overdue invoices incur a 1.5% monthly fee. Pay now to avoid service interruption.
